page.title: Cheat sheet · tinyactors CLI
page.description: Reference sheet of tinyactors CLI commands by task, covering compilation, validation, formatting, inspection, diffing, graphing, execution, and snapshot reading.

hero.headline: Common tinyactors command lines by task
hero.lede: Copy and adapt tinyactors commands for compiling, checking, inspecting, graphing, comparing, and running statecharts and reading offline snapshots.

section.heading: Compile and check charts
section.code:
# Compile two charts into one image tinyactors compile order.scxml payment.scxml -o order.tai
# Emit a compiled chart as a C source array tinyactors compile order.scxml --emit c --symbol order_image -o order_image.c
# Validate multiple SCXML files tinyactors check charts/*.scxml
# Treat all lint warnings except unsent-event as errors tinyactors lint --deny all --allow unsent-event system.xml
# Check whether SCXML files match canonical formatting tinyactors fmt --check charts/*.scxml

section.heading: Inspect chart structure
section.code:
# Summarize the contents of a compiled image tinyactors inspect order.tai
# List all states in a chart tinyactors states order.scxml
# Output transitions from an image as JSON tinyactors transitions -f json order.tai
# List every event of a system's charts tinyactors events system.xml
# List only guard condition expressions tinyactors expressions --kind condition order.scxml

section.heading: Trace paths and draw graphs
section.code:
# Find the shortest way to shipped tinyactors path order.scxml --to shipped
# Confirm paid cannot be reached from cancelled tinyactors path order.scxml --from cancelled --to paid --unreachable
# Render a statechart diagram as SVG tinyactors graph -f svg order.scxml > order.svg
# Render a left-to-right diagram with the dark theme tinyactors graph -f svg --direction right --theme dark order.scxml > order.svg
# Render a top-level diagram with checkout folded tinyactors graph -f svg --depth 1 --fold checkout shop.scxml > overview.svg

section.heading: Compare chart versions
section.code:
# Compare a compiled image against an SCXML file tinyactors diff order-v1.tai order-v2.scxml
# Fail with a non-zero exit code on breaking changes tinyactors diff --breaking --exit-code deployed.tai order.scxml
# Output structural differences for one chart as JSON tinyactors diff -f json --chart order old.tai new.tai

section.heading: Run charts and scripts
section.code:
# Serve a host for one chart on standard input tinyactors run order.scxml
# Run multiple charts with a configuration file tinyactors run --config shop.json order.scxml payment.scxml
# Drive a chart over JSON-RPC from standard input tinyactors run --io-processor payments --system shop order.scxml < requests.jsonl
# Write the JSON-RPC schema to a file tinyactors run --schema > run.schema.json

section.heading: Read snapshots and blobs
section.code:
# Summarize the contents of a snapshot file tinyactors inspect shop.snapshot
# Check whether a blob wakes in the snapshot's host tinyactors inspect order-17.blob shop.snapshot
# List all actors recorded in a snapshot tinyactors actors shop.snapshot
# Filter snapshot actors by chart name and session tinyactors actors --chart order --session 17 shop.snapshot
# List the states of segment 1's charts tinyactors states --segment 1 shop.snapshot
